title: Website release consistency
objective: Align public website release claims with the unsigned Windows preview contract and refresh canonical generated reference provenance without changing release workflow or publication authority

oracles: WINDOWS.md and the checked release workflow define Windows artifacts as an explicit unsigned preview
pnpm docs:generate is the sole authority for generated reference-data and derived reference HTML hashes

handoff.summary: Corrected the website's Windows distribution claims to match the checked release contract: the Windows x64 preview ZIP is deliberately unsigned, checksum- and provenance-bound, and Authenticode remains a future separately gated state. Added a focused regression that reads WINDOWS.md and the release workflow as oracles without changing either authority. Reproduced pnpm docs:generate from exact base 0ae559238dd4b0a07b53dbd126630cf46a9c6aa0 and committed only its canonical reference-data and reference HTML output: 75 line fields, 29 start_line fields, one current-source excerpt, and the derived HTML data hash changed; no API content, signatures, documentation prose, Prism assets, workflow, README, or publication authority changed. Exact source commit f5dec014211870e30ad95b842fc5b9392b60c794 passed pnpm docs:check, the focused website suite (9/9), pnpm test:portable (447/447), and pnpm test:baselib:strict (zero errors).
risks: The exact-source pnpm test:tutorial aggregate failed after 254.991 seconds with 656 passes and six failures, all in inherited src/doc/en/tutorial/tour_rings.rst examples at lines 77, 78, 81, 82, 84, and 86. The first failure is i = CC(i) raising ReferenceError: local variable 'i' referenced before assignment; the remaining five are direct cascades. This lane changes only website data, generated reference coordinates/hash, the focused website test, and its task contract, so it cannot correct or legitimately claim a pass for that runtime/compiler failure.

The public wording is consistent with the current explicitly unsigned Windows preview contract. A future Authenticode rollout must update the release authority and its acceptance evidence before changing these claims.
next_steps: Integrate the source commit and this closure after the approved baseline checkpoint, then rerun the final aggregate gates on the assembled baseline.
Scope the inherited tour_rings local-before-assignment regression to a separate compiler/tutorial lane; preserve this failed receipt until that fix is independently validated.
Keep Windows artifacts described as unsigned preview archives until a distinct Authenticode gate and signed acceptance receipts exist.
